title: Universe export
note: Local and self-host move exports use --pause-source to stop writers and drain client sessions, bind one snapshot to the archive and receipt, and remain paused until explicit universe resume. A backup without the flag carries False and cannot enter hosted replacement. Hosted Prepare archive pauses only its source, with polled phases Checking access, Pausing source, Finishing active work, Exporting database, Packing archive, Uploading archive, and Archive ready; source paused. Hosted Prepare archive refuses with export_live_work while open work claims or unfinished deployment runs exist, lists up to 20 of them, and leaves the source running; end the listed work, then Prepare archive again. Hosted engine admins can request a read-only archive estimate (estimated_bytes, estimated_dump_bytes, artifact_bytes) without pausing the source; estimates over a limit return export_size_limit or export_disk_limit. Prepare archive starts only on an explicit POST; other GETs do not start or pause an export. Phase status shows elapsed seconds and bytes. The completed signed link offers Download archive and Copy link with an absolute expiry time; Resume source restores the source explicitly. Import shows Fetching archive, Verifying archive, Checking destination, and Replacing universe before receipt status. Refusals and recovery stay in the active dialog; interrupted import responses recover the durable receipt before suggesting another attempt. Export completion is not destination acceptance. Artifact transfer uses caller-owned routing and an injectable S3 client factory for hosted credentials. Local and self-host archives upload through the destination org machine connection: universe upload streams signed multipart bytes directly to storage, renews URLs for slow transfers and prints the fresh signed source link, expiry and dashboard Import page. It refuses a connection belonging to another org. PostgreSQL admission closes the original source to every client, including older engines, while export and paused self-host authentication read a frozen copy. The copy needs additional database space and is removed after Resume. Server/import coordination stays on a maintenance-database lock. Failed Resume refences the source; any writes accepted during the explicit attempt remain. Output-folder write access is checked before pausing; an unavailable path gives universe_export_destination_unavailable without stopping writers. The completion summary names included paths and missing file counts and keys. Export and estimate keep confirmed absent bytes as artifact_source_absent and unavailable handles or owners as artifact_handle_or_owner_unavailable. Other read failures refuse with archive_artifact_unreadable and access or checkout recovery; files over the per-file limit refuse with archive_artifact_too_large. Exclude artifacts explicitly to bypass file transfer. A refused paused export keeps the source paused and names universe resume. Hosted export refusal directs to Prepare archive in the dashboard Universe portability controls. Unsupported archive-format readers refuse with archive_tool_version_unsupported and instruct matching or newer PostgreSQL tools, preserving the original archive. Hosted sources resume through Resume source in the dashboard Universe portability controls. Authority comparisons exclude UI preferences, frontend rate admission, and merge-queue observation cadence; their rows and owned sequences remain protected by the archive checksum. Project content and repository bindings retain their authority checks. Archive estimates use reltuples times summed pg_stats avg_width plus TOAST table storage, excluding indexes and reusable heap space. Missing column statistics or negative reltuples use pg_table_size instead. VACUUM ANALYZE refreshes estimates after pruning; dump-time and staging caps remain enforced.
